propositions: Backend-neutral core modules outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py load Jira-specific adapters by literal lazy-load keys, causing vendor code execution for any configured backend.

Comment body formatting, truncation, and ADF decoding must route through port abstractions (FieldSanitizer.fit_comment and InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text) instead of direct vendor module lazy-loading.

The FieldSanitizer port gains fit_comment method (pure fit-to-limit, no warning) separate from sanitize_comment (send-side with warning), and InboundMapper gains normalize_rich_text for vendor-neutral rich-text decoding.
Literal lazy-load keys at outbound_comments.py:68,71 and inbound_translate.py:315 must be deleted; public surface _normalize_adf_body stays and reroutes through the port.

A sweep test must verify no core module at package root contains the literal string rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira, with a recorded exemption for inbound_fields.py (the Jira InboundMapper implementation).
